info.title: cxagent — a coding agent for the terminal
info.description: A coding agent that works in your checkout: sub-agent delegation, a permission gate on every tool call, MCP servers, and resumable sessions. Bring your own model — Anthropic, OpenAI-compatible or Ollama.

x-inspectra.cliParsedTitle: cxagent — a terminal AI coding agent

options.name: --instance
options.description:
Start on a named provider from config.json instead of the
default. The status line shows which one is live.

options.name: --theme
options.description:
Start in a named theme, case-insensitive. An unknown name
falls back to 'cxagent' rather than refusing
to start. Available themes:
Amber, Crimson, cxagent, Daylight, Forest, ModernGray, Ocean, Slate

options.name: --config-dir
options.description:
Use DIR for config.json, history and session state instead
of the usual location. Useful for a throwaway setup that
leaves your real one alone.

options.name: --resume
options.description:
Reopen the last session in this folder, or a specific one
by id. Without an id it takes the most recent.

options.name: --sessions
options.description:
List this folder's sessions and exit. 'all' lists every
folder's.

options.name: --mock
options.description:
Run against a scripted provider instead of a real model.
Nothing is sent anywhere and nothing is spent.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Print this and exit.
CONFIGURATION
Providers, agent types, MCP servers and permissions live in config.json under
your config directory. Run cxagent once with no configuration and it offers to
write one.
MORE
/help inside the app lists what you can type at the prompt.
https://github.com/nickprotop/cxagent
